title: Te Reo o te Whakaaro Nui
intro: I mua, i whakapuakina e te reo ngawari o te whakaaro nui ngā tohutohu e hipa ana i te wā. Nā tēnei tangata, i manaakitia ki te māramatanga hohonu, i tuku mai i ngā akoranga tino nui e waiho tonu ana hei tohu mō te hunga katoa e hiahia ana ki te arataki. Ka taea e koe te wetewete i te tuakiri kei muri i ēnei kupu pumau?
clues: I homai e te Atua ki ahau tētahi manaakitanga nui, he taonga i whakamārama i tōku ngākau me tōku hinengaro.
I tahuri ahau ki taku tamaiti aroha, me te hiahia ki te tohatoha i te taonga tino nui i a au.
I whakatūpato ahau ko te hē nui rawa atu ko te whakatū hoa mahi ki te Atua Kotahi pono.
I whakamahara ahau ahakoa te taumaha o te purapura sinapi, e huna ana i roto i te toka, i tua atu rānei i te rangi, ka whakawakia e Allah.
I ako ahau kia ngohengohe ki ngā mātua, engari ko te ngohengohe he mea tika anake.
I whakaako ahau i ngā tikanga māmā: haere me te ngākau mahaki i runga i te whenua, kia āta whakarongo hoki ki tō reo; ko te tangi nui rawa atu hoki ko te aue o te kaihe.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
